Added `/admin` with a per-request session role check. Non-admin users reach a styled forbidden page through Next.js’s `forbidden()` boundary, which returns **HTTP 403**. The route and error page are in [app/admin/page.tsx](/workspace/app/admin/page.tsx) and [app/admin/forbidden.tsx](/workspace/app/admin/forbidden.tsx); [next.config.ts](/workspace/next.config.ts) enables the required auth boundary.

The production build passed, and a request to `/admin` returned `403 Forbidden` with the error page. The current session helper is mocked as a regular user, so `/admin` will show that page until the session source changes.
